tabeditor.name: Tab name
tabeditor.title: Title
tabeditor.help.title:
Filter by quests whose title contains what you type. Use commas to match any of several words, and put ! before a word to leave those out. Example: to filter by quests that have the word "crop" but not Robin, type in:
crop, !Robin
tabeditor.help.source:
Filter by quests from a certain source, like a mod name. Use commas to match any, and ! to leave some out. Example: to filter by quests that are from More Quests or Mr. Qi, type in:
Mr Qi, More Quests
tabeditor.help.category: Filter by quests in a certain category (categories come from More Quests Framework). Use commas to match any, and ! to leave some out. Vanilla and non MQF quests have no category.
tabeditor.help.kind: Filter by a certain type of quest, like a daily board quest or a special order. Spaces don't matter, so Special Orders works. Put ! before it to hide them, like !Special Orders.
tabeditor.help.deadline:
Filter by quests by deadline. Several comparators available. Examples:

Match quests that have 3 days left, type: 3
Match quests that have 5 days or less: <=5
Match quests that have more than 10 days: >10
Match quests with deadline within 1 to 4 days: 1-4
Match all quests with limited deadline: !None
To match quests with no deadline, type: None

You can mix and match combinations with comma. For example, to match quests with deadline between 1 to 10 days EXCEPT 5 days, type: 1-10, !5
config.openKey.tooltip: The hotkey that opens the Quest Journal.
config.controller.link.tooltip: Rebind the gamepad buttons used inside the journal (tab switching, new tab, edit tab).
config.controller.note: These buttons work while the journal is open. The tab strip can't be reached with the stick, so tabs are switched with these instead.
config.prevTab.tooltip: Switches to the tab on the left. Defaults to the left shoulder and left trigger.
config.nextTab.tooltip: Switches to the tab on the right. Defaults to the right shoulder and right trigger.
config.editTab.tooltip: Opens the editor for the selected tab when it's one of your own custom tabs. Defaults to Y.
config.addTab.tooltip: Opens the editor to create a new custom tab. Defaults to X.
config.hudActivate.tooltip: Point at a pinned quest on the HUD (move the pointer with the right stick) and press this to open it in the journal. Defaults to A.
config.gameMenuTab.tooltip: Adds a Quest Journal tab to the in-game menu (the one you open with Esc). Needs the Better Game Menu mod, otherwise the tab is skipped so it doesn't clash with other menu-tab mods. You can always open the journal with the F6 hotkey or the Iconic Framework icon. Takes effect after a restart.
config.hudPin: Show pinned quests on the HUD
config.hudPin.tooltip: Draws your pinned quests in the top-right corner while you're playing.
config.pinNew.tooltip: Automatically pins a quest to the HUD the moment you accept it.
config.markRead: Clear the new-quest mark on open
config.markRead.tooltip: When on, opening this journal counts as checking your quests, so the vanilla quest button stops flashing its new-quest mark. Quests waiting on a reward keep flashing until you collect it.
config.debugLogging.tooltip: Writes extra status messages to the SMAPI console. Handy for bug reports. Warnings and errors always show.
config.scale.tooltip: Makes the whole journal window bigger or smaller. Reopen the journal for a change to apply.
config.sort.tooltip: The order the quests list starts in. You can also change it from the dropdown inside the journal.
config.completeCheat.tooltip: Adds a button that finishes a quest and pays its reward without doing the objective. It's a shortcut, so it's off by default.
config.itemCheats.tooltip: Adds a button that gives you the item a quest asks for (or advances a fishing quest's catch count). It's a shortcut, so it's off by default.
config.warpCheat.tooltip: Adds a button that warps you next to a quest's NPC. Off by default.
